questions.q: What image does the summary use for a modern career?
a: A jungle gym with many routes to the top
A ladder with fixed and evenly spaced rungs
A maze that has only one exit
A staircase that only goes upward
questions.why: Lesson 1 says careers no longer follow a single ladder.

questions.q: What goal horizon does the summary suggest pairing with a long-term dream?
a: Eighteen-month goals
Five-year goals
Weekly goals
Ten-year goals
questions.why: Lesson 1 says short-term goals give direction without too much pressure.

questions.q: What is the tightrope women walk at work, according to the summary?
a: Balancing ambition with being seen as likable
Choosing between salary and job title
Balancing business travel with family time
Weighing loyalty against honesty
questions.why: Lesson 2 says too much ambition reads as rude, too little makes you easy to dismiss.

questions.q: What communication tactic does the summary suggest for women?
a: Argue for a group and cite facts instead of saying I want
Speak more loudly than your colleagues do
Avoid giving any clear opinion in meetings
Use humor to deflect every request
questions.why: Lesson 2 says generalizing and quoting statistics makes points land better.

questions.q: What does leaning in mean in the summary?
a: Pursue promotions and opportunities before motherhood arrives
Working longer hours than the rest of your team
Asking for a smaller workload to reduce stress
Leaving a job early to care for your family
questions.why: Lesson 3 warns against holding back early for children you do not have yet.
